verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, so committing and pushing from the device is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never mentions git or any version-control command. The listed bundled commands (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex) and pkg-installable tools (zip, unzip, xz, ffmpeg) include nothing for commit or push.
